integrity: Exact proofs and a standalone numerical checker are included; numerical checks do not prove infinite statements. This work has no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact variance and asymptotic laws hold for even iid exponential samples, independent random perfect matchings and the zero-threshold baseline only. No claims about positive/adaptive thresholds, broader historical novelty or published calibration errors. The projection constant is a convergent integral, not an elementary closed form.
title: Exact variance and a Gaussian law for permutation-averaged exponential pair contrasts
